maddeler.e:
استحصلوا (form X)
# اِسْتَحْصَلُوا (istaḥṣalū) /is.taħ.sˤa.luː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَحْصَلَ (istaḥṣala)
# اُسْتُحْصِلُوا (ustuḥṣilū) /us.tuħ.sˤi.luː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَحْصَلَ (istaḥṣala)
# اِسْتَحْصِلُوا (istaḥṣilū) /is.taħ.sˤi.luː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَحْصَلَ (istaḥṣala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
